items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, then there was a drummer we had called Tootinan, he was from Mobile.

ctx.x: He went over to Texas around 1914, I think, and stayed over that way. Yeah.

We got some Texas musicians, too, from there, from Houston. L.C. Tolan, and Marquiva Spreex, and who else? I don't remember. Well, then there was a drummer we had called Tootinan, he was from Mobile. And another New Orleans boy was Ray Dugas. Yes, yes, yes.
